name: RACE
ability_definition: The ability to read and understand information and ideas presented in writing.

task_realism.reasoning: Reading human-written prose and inferring facts, main ideas and author intent is central to workplace reading. However, RACE passages are short general-interest texts from Chinese middle- and high-school English exams: stories, news snippets and expository pieces. They are not the memos, manuals, contracts, reports, regulations or technical documents that workers actually read.

evaluation_conditions.reasoning: Models are fine-tuned on about 90k in-distribution training questions and tested on the same exam distribution. The passages are short and self-contained, with no time pressure, stakes, ambiguity or need to find relevant information within long or messy documents. Real work involves unfamiliar domains, lengthy multi-document contexts and consequential decisions that depend on correct reading. Known annotation and item-quality artifacts (STARC 2020) also let models exploit answer-option cues.

construct_coverage.reasoning: It covers a reasonable spread of comprehension subskills: detail retrieval, inference, summarization, vocabulary in context and author attitude. It leaves out long-document comprehension, technical or domain-specific text, procedural instructions, tables and structured documents, and synthesis across sources. Its difficulty ceiling is a high-school English learner's exam, a narrow slice of adult workplace reading.

format_match.reasoning: The input prose is a realistic artifact, but the output is a forced choice among four distractor-designed options. Workplace comprehension shows up as acting on instructions, answering open questions, summarizing or making decisions, not as picking A-D. Multiple choice also allows elimination strategies and cue exploitation that have no workplace analogue.

transferability_reasoning: RACE tests genuine prose comprehension, including inference and author intent, with human-written passages and questions designed by instructors, which gives it moderate construct relevance. Its transfer to workplace reading is limited by short school-exam passages, in-distribution fine-tuning, the absence of long or domain-specific documents, and a forced four-way multiple-choice format. High RACE accuracy therefore indicates solid basic reading comprehension but says little about reliably understanding real work documents.

2020.metric: accuracy (%) on RACE test set (RACE-M + RACE-H combined)
2020.human_reference: General adult / relevant educated workforce who read work-related written material in English

2021.metric: accuracy (%) on the RACE test set (RACE-M and RACE-H combined)
2021.human_reference: Relevant educated workforce: literate adults who read written English material in work settings (general reading comprehension, not specialists)
